name: Practical Christian Living
overview: Practical Christian living calls believers to prioritize God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that their needs will be met as a result (Matthew 6:33). It begins with repentance and baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, receiving the Holy Spirit as a gift to empower a transformed life (Acts 2:38). True Christian living rejects legalistic requirements for salvation, focusing instead on faith in Christ who lives in the believer (Acts 15:1; Galatians 2:20). This transformation involves renewing the mind to discern God’s perfect will and guarding against unbelief that leads away from God (Romans 12:2; Hebrews 3:12).
